title: Amar Singh Mobilizes a Coalition Against Baghel Singh

blocks.text: After news arrives that Baghel Singh is advancing, Amar Singh refuses to show anxiety and instead boasts that a determined assault will strip his rival of territory. Orders go out in every direction to reach his fort at the earliest, turning alarm into a full political and military mobilization.

The page lingers over the breadth of the coalition he gathers. Allied chiefs, kinsmen, and neighboring powers are summoned, while drums, cavalry, and a visible battery of artillery guns create the spectacle of an army meant to intimidate before battle even begins.
This page is about posture. Amar Singh seeks victory first by scale, display, and confident messaging, presenting himself as the stronger chief before either side has actually tested the field.
